items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Sereno's wife, Marge, had been singing in his band

ctx.x: Oh, she was living in Hawaii.

She was living there. She had gone over to sing with a band, Eddie Sereno's band. Eddie Sereno's wife, Marge, had been singing in his band, she became pregnant and couldn't sing, so they sent for Toni -- and that's how I met Toni. And I hired her to sing in my band.
